passages.excerpt_preview: There is now remorse in the Beloved of the Gods after he conquered the Kalingas.

passages.locator: victory by dhamma the chief victory
passages.excerpt_preview: The Beloved of the Gods considers victory by dhamma the chief victory.
One should not honour only one's own sect and condemn other sects without reason.

passages.locator: One hundred and fifty thousand were carried away
passages.excerpt_preview: One hundred and fifty thousand were carried away, one hundred thousand were killed and many times that number died.

passages.locator: King Piyadasi, beloved of the gods
passages.excerpt_preview: hen he had been consecrated eight years, King Piyadasi, beloved of the gods, conquered the Kalingas.

passages.locator: The king has caused this dhamma edict to be written
passages.excerpt_preview: The king has caused this dhamma edict to be written so that it may endure long.
Everywhere in the dominions of the Beloved of the Gods, and among his borderers, medical treatment for men and medical treatment for animals has been arranged.

passages.locator: affairs of the people at all times
passages.excerpt_preview: The king desires that his officials should be informed of the affairs of the people at all times and in all places.
